stem: What is the main risk of prolonged hydrogel use on major burns?
explanation: Induced hypothermia is the main risk because hydrogels provide prolonged cooling and can lower core temperature when used over large burn areas.

optionExplanations.A: Correct because hydrogels can cool a large burn surface for an extended period and may cause a dangerous drop in core temperature.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because infection can complicate burns, but prolonged hydrogel use is primarily associated with hypothermia.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because hydrogels are not typically associated with chemical irritation of the dermis.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because hydrogels are moist dressings and do not primarily cause dehydration of the burn wound.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because delayed assessment may occur with any dressing, but it is not the main risk highlighted for prolonged hydrogel use.

source.hint: Think about the systemic effect of uncontrolled cooling on a patient who has lost skin integrity.
